headline: Indian Retail Investors Post $353 Million in Gains From Global Stocks
summary: Indian retail investors recorded $353 million in gains from global stocks, with participation on cross-border investment platforms rising 51% in 2026.
why: Growing retail participation in foreign assets highlights increasing cross-border capital flows and portfolio diversification among emerging market investors.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Retail investors gained positive returns from international portfolio allocations.
